dialogues.speaker: Uncle Sun
dialogues.text: Ah, another patron! Would you like to purchase some fish?

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Sun
dialogues.text: Things are different during Lantern Rite, let me tell you. Everything's super fresh! Lantern Rite-special-super-fresh, in fact!

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Sun
dialogues.text: It is the festive season, after all! People buy more, we import more, and the fish are all the fresher for it. Wouldn't you agree?

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Sun
dialogues.text: Ah, another patron! Would you like to purchase some fish?

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Sun
dialogues.text: I promise that all my fish are fre—... No, super fresh!

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Sun
dialogues.text: What do you mean by "super fresh"?

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Sun
dialogues.text: The only fish that I sell here are "super fresh" fish.

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Sun
dialogues.text: It might not sound like there's much difference between fresh and super fresh, but they couldn't be more different. In terms of size, or quality, you name it. They're worlds apart!

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Sun
dialogues.text: And I can guarantee one thing for sure: my prices are better than the opposite stand over there.

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Sun
dialogues.text: The opposite stand...

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Sun
dialogues.text: *sigh* You see, not long ago we were both charging higher prices, but my fish were selling better because they were more fresh.

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Sun
dialogues.text: Then, Uncle Gao started lowering his prices, probably just jealous of all the business I was getting. Before I knew it, I was stuck in a price war with him.

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Sun
dialogues.text: So in order to provide fresh fish to everyone at a reasonable price, I decided to lower my prices to just breaking even...

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Sun
dialogues.text: *sigh* I don't know how long I can keep my prices so low. I can only count on the support of all my local customers at this point.

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Sun
dialogues.text: Thank you, goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Sun
dialogues.text: Take care, now. And thanks for your loyal support, haha.

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Sun
dialogues.text: Buy some super fresh fish.

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Sun
dialogues.text: Choose whichever you like, they're all super fresh.

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Gao
dialogues.text: How was business today, brother?

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Sun
dialogues.text: Here, let's just say this is a token of my appreciation, all thanks to your plan!

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Gao
dialogues.text: Haw-haw, they won't suspect a thing. This is all going just as I planned it would.

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Sun
dialogues.text: That's my Uncle Gao! There's no way anyone would ever remotely suspect that we're in cahoots. As soon as they compare our prices, they'll surely think that I'm the only one getting any business.

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Gao
dialogues.text: Hahaha! Come now, Uncle Sun! Bottoms up!

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Sun
dialogues.text: Here, let me fill that up for ya!

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Gao
dialogues.text: Aye! Tonight will be a night that we never remember, hahaha!

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Sun
dialogues.text: Enough talking, now drink up!
